column1: # TITLE: Gene expression profiling of two NSCLC cell lines treated with PAEP/glycodelin expression stimulating substances

# SUMMARY: We compared H1975 and 2106T cells treated with PAEP/glycodelin expression inducing substances and the corresponding contol treated cells. Gene expression profiling of H1975 and 2106T cells with induced PAEP/glycodelin expression might give hints on several pathways regulating this activated expression.
